Replace path-based UI builders only behind a mobile presentation bridge; PC fallback unchanged.

supplementaryCoverage.note: Native UI states, source schemas/methods and config objects remain in immutable Phase01 inventory; linked rather than duplicated or edited.

navigationPolicies.modalFocus: one top input owner; suspended views retain data but do not receive pointer/submit
navigationPolicies.worldInput: raycast dimmer plus UI block query for direct polling/physics input; simulation clock unchanged
navigationPolicies.pending: only while an actual operation/ad is in progress; do not fake server pending for local synchronous commands
navigationPolicies.routeFailure: retry presentation only; never replay spend/grant/delete
navigationPolicies.timeOwnership: unscaled UI animations; existing main-menu/exit ownership retained; router never assumes timeScale1

implementationBindingLedgerSchema.currentlyKnown: all source FeatureIDs, route/component/role and original command/data/selector contracts
implementationBindingLedgerSchema.currentlyUnknown: new Unity asset GUID/fileID and runtime test result; intentionally not fabricated
